meta.name: design-dna
meta.description: Extract, define, and apply design DNA across three dimensions: design system (tokens), design style (qualitative feel), and visual effects (Canvas, WebGL, 3D, particles, shaders, scroll effects, etc.). Use this skill when: (1) a user wants to see the full 3-dimension design structure/schema, (2) a user provides images, screenshots, or URLs of reference designs and wants them analyzed into a structured JSON profile covering all three dimensions, (3) a user has a Design DNA JSON and content and wants a design generated from it, or (4) any combination of these phases. Triggers on "design DNA", "extract design style", "analyze design", "design tokens from reference", "generate design from JSON", "design system from screenshot", "design profile", "style guide JSON", "visual effects analysis", "design with effects", "3d design analysis".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析参考设计,提取风格并生成新设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把参考设计的风格提炼出来,并应用到自己的作品上。
copy.tagline_en: Extract design DNA from references and generate consistent designs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to derive design style from screenshots and apply it to new designs.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能分析你给的参考图或链接，提取颜色、字体、风格等设计特征，整理成设计档案；也能根据档案和内容，生成匹配的网页设计。
howto.when: 当你想看设计结构、分析参考图/链接成设计档案、或按已有设计JSON生成设计时触发。触发词如“design DNA”“analyze design”等。

say.text: 分析这张参考图，输出完整的设计DNA JSON。
say.note: 它会测量颜色并生成三段式设计档案。

say.text: 把这份设计DNA JSON套用在这篇文案上，生成一个落地页。
say.note: 它会解析JSON并产出可运行的HTML页面。

say.text: 先展示设计DNA的三维结构schema。
say.note: 它会列出字段说明并询问是否定制。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze reference images or links, extract design features such as colors, fonts, and style, and compile them into a design profile; it can also generate matching web designs from that profile and your content.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to see the design structure, analyze a reference image/link into a design profile, or generate a design from an existing Design DNA JSON. Keywords include 'design DNA', 'analyze design', etc.

say_en.text: Analyze this reference image and output the complete Design DNA JSON.
say_en.note: It will measure colors and produce the three-dimension profile.

say_en.text: Apply this Design DNA JSON to this copy and generate a landing page.
say_en.note: It will parse the JSON and output runnable HTML.

say_en.text: Show me the design DNA 3-dimension schema first.
say_en.note: It will list fields and ask about customization.
